name: component-consulting
description: Component consultant for AI-built frontends and HTML decks. Given a site's goal/message and its DESIGN.md design tokens, it prescribes WHICH proven open-source gallery component fills each job-slot, HOW to remap it to the tokens, and WHERE to place it — so the page is message-coherent, token-true, and lands in the distinctive/awwwards band instead of average-AI bland or flashy-for-its-own-sake. 5-axis gates-first fit rubric (Token, Message-gate, UX+backend, Distinctiveness, House-override) + live-scan of ~15 component galleries via WebFetch/WebSearch. Use when asked 'what components should I use', '컴포넌트 추천', or right after a DESIGN.md exists and before building. Design.md posture: consumes.
